{{Quote|I tell you now, Garnet. You bad smuggler. Verr bad. Make Mogroch angry.''"<br />"''Mogroch's got to wait. I&hellip;''"<br />"''No wait! Wait long enough. Two days, Garnet. Two days, 10,000 credits. Two days to live for you.|A Muur and Roark Garnet|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
The '''Muurs''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="TRG1" /> hailing from<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Muuria system/Legends|Muuria system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Their body featured numerous [[Limb/Legends|tentacles]], which could be strong enough to allow to fling a [[Human/Legends|Human]] across a room. Muurs could speak in a hissing and spitting manner and could also laugh.<ref name="TRG1" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]]-speaking [[Unidentified Muur|Muur]] worked as an enforcer for the being [[Mogroch]]. At one point, the Muur confronted the Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] about the latter's outstanding debt of ten thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to his employer. The Muur used two of his tentacles to choke Garnet and also remove the Human's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and, after the enforcer had delivered his warning, he threw Garnet across the room and rapidly left the room they were in.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Muur species was introduced in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" />
